Name: Cloudintel KV Crypto Wrap (<SBCI_ENV>)
Description: Least-privilege Key Vault crypto role for the sbci-API managed identity's evidence envelope-encryption path (plan §6 CI-P6 IaC #3/#4, contract §2 'get/wrap'). Grants read of the key plus wrapKey ONLY (the API wraps a per-evidence data key with the KV master key; it never unwraps). This SPLITS the built-in 'Key Vault Crypto User' role, which bundles encrypt/decrypt/wrapKey/unwrapKey/sign/verify — the API had no business holding unwrapKey (or decrypt). Both permissions are Key Vault DATA actions; the management Actions list is empty. Scope the ASSIGNMENT to the vault (see ensure_kv_role_assignments in cloudintel-azure.sh). NOTE: data-action custom roles can lag RBAC propagation (~5min) on first assignment; a fresh apply may see AuthorizationFailed briefly before it settles.
